headline: Bears QB Williams out for MNF; backup Bagent back at practice
summary: Bears QB Caleb Williams is out for Monday's game against the Eagles, and backup Tyson Bagent returned to the practice field while still in the concussion protocol.

headline: Giants Exploring QB Options But Plan To Stick With Jameis Winston
summary: The Giants are exploring potential quarterback additions following a knee injury to Jaxson Dart that is expected to sideline the second-year quarterback for the rest of the regular season. headline: Matt Judon, three others work out for 49ers with Nick Bosa injured
summary: 49ers defensive end Nick Bosa is out for Sunday's game with a calf injury and he is expected to miss more time, so the team looked at a few options to bolster the position on Saturday.

headline: QB Sam Darnold back Sunday, but Seahawks down two safeties
summary: Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold will start Sunday, but the defending Super Bowl champions will be without both starting safeties as Julian Love and Ty Okada have been ruled out.

headline: Sources: Packers sign OG Tomlinson off Cowboys' practice squad
summary: The Packers have added some much-needed offensive line help by signing veteran guard Laken Tomlinson off the Cowboys' practice squad, according to the NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo.
